# REASONABLE TECH Workspace Instructions

- Project goal: create a modern startup-style landing page and API service.
- Keep frontend and backend decoupled but usable together from the root workspace.
- Prefer clean, minimal, production-ready code and clear documentation.
- Use Vite + React for the frontend and Express for the backend.
- Verify build/test status before claiming the project is ready.
- Update this file as the project evolves.
